name: Csákvár (Hungary)
description: White field with narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the hoist edge and yellow and green at the fly edge, charged at the centre with the town arms of Csákvár: a crowned red shield with a white charge, with green and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csákvár arms with crown and mantling
